<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_USI_Course_Registration" targetNamespace="http://www.sports-institute.example/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_USI_Registration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_USI_Registration"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Participant_Twitter"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_USI_Registration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RegisterForCourse" name="Register for course">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckSlots" name="Check free slots">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsFree" name="Slots free?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoSlots" name="No slots available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesDates" name="Show courses and dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course and date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasAccount" name="Already has account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check registration at eligible university">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" name="Registered at eligible university?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountReady" name="Account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueTicket" name="Issue course ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RegisterForCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckSlots" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsFree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Gateway_HasAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_HasAccount" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountReady" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
